title: Remove the inert .gitattributes merge=beads directive for a gitignored path
why: `.beads/` is git-ignored at the repo root, and `git ls-files | grep beads` confirms `.beads/issues.jsonl` has never been tracked. A `merge=` custom-merge-driver attribute only ever activates during a git merge of a tracked file, so this line can never fire. Even setting that aside, no `merge.beads.driver` command is registered anywhere in the repo (no hooks/, tool/, or doc sets it via `git config`) — so even a force-added copy of the file would hit 'unable to find custom merge driver beads' rather than actually merging. This is dead scaffolding for a workflow (the beads issue tracker) that isn't wired into this repo.
recommendation: Either delete the .gitattributes line (if beads isn't used here), or un-ignore .beads/issues.jsonl and add a committed setup step that registers `git config merge.beads.driver`.
acceptance_criteria: Either .gitattributes no longer references a driver that's never registered, or the driver is registered by a committed script and the target path is tracked.

corrections: '.beads/issues.jsonl has never been tracked' is false: commit 34643e55 added it and commit 8aa6c1dd ('chore: Remove beads in favor of gastown') deliberately removed it. It's leftover scaffolding from a deprecated tool switch, not something never wired up -- doesn't change the current-state inertness conclusion. AG-1 citation is also a mismatch; this is really a Fowler dead-code observation.
